digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions gerrit-verify pytest matrix / reusable _build-and-test workflow
propositions: GitHub Actions Gerrit Verified Gate runs hang at the 99% default-suite progress line for hours and require manual cancellation to clear the queue.
Affected stale Gerrit patchsets omit fix commit 96a0d5c3f, retaining unbounded per-blob lazy git fetch on a blobless partial clone during ticket-tree materialization.
The reusable _build-and-test.yml test job declares no timeout-minutes, so hung jobs run to the 360-minute GitHub default and hold hosted runner slots until manually cleared.
A pager contract defect where FakeJiraClient.search_issues ignores startAt/maxResults causes _paged_search/get_comment_map to loop indefinitely on a non-empty page.
The fix adds jobs.test.timeout-minutes: 60 to bound the pytest matrix job, verified via a config-as-artifact oracle observed RED before and GREEN after the edit.
